notes: UWP original launched via uwp-app-runner (Release, PID 33272, window 'Compression C# Sample') and captured as the golden baseline. The migrated WinUI 3 app builds, launches (PID 21696, own top-level window), and is structurally + behaviorally faithful: full UIA tree laid out with valid on-screen coordinates for all controls, the 'Compress File...' button is live (opens a real FileOpenPicker), the ComboBox expands, and Scenario1.xaml.cs preserves the compress/decompress + description-switch + NotifyUser logic verbatim. Compare-Parity.ps1 = PASS (coverage 2/2, actions 1/1 live, 0 regressions). HOWEVER, the WinUI 3 XAML content did not composite to a capturable/visible surface in this session: every winapp screenshot of the main window is blank white and the ComboBox popup renders black, while the same tool captured the UWP golden fully and the native file dialog rendered fine. This is a WinUI-3 swapchain render/capture limitation of the environment, not a dropped scenario or dead control. Because visual fidelity could not be confirmed against the golden (no non-blank WinUI screenshot exists), the single scenario is graded PARTIAL rather than PASS.
